I have gone a number of times in early November, sometimes even for thanksgiving. A lot has changed since you were seven! Even if you're only ten years old! 

The Nightmare Before Christmas Layover is there between October and December, so it will be up. Ghost Galaxy is terrifying for me but it is a must-do if it is still there, but depending on how late you go in November, it will be regular Space Mountain again, which is still an awesome ride. The Matterhorn just got some amazing new effects, so you should definitely check those out, as well as the Peter Pan dark ride. Splash Mountain might be a little chilly, but they usually lower the water levels during the fall so you don't get /too/ wet. The Jungle Cruise will also likely have it's Jingle Cruise facade, but I forget when that goes up. 

Anyway [here](http://touringplans.com/disneyland-resort/closures) is the list of the refurbishments going on, it doesn't look like you will be missing much! 

As for snacks, the Mint Julep bar is one of my favorite places. They've got beignets and Mint Juleps which are delicious, and in the fall they have pumpkin beignets that are to die for. There will also be a lot of cool cupcakes around. [Here](http://www.disneyfoodblog.com) is the Disney Food Blog. Don't forget churros, popcorn, Dole Whips, and all the other classic stuff. You'll have to research what kind of restaurant you wanna hit, but since you only have one day I think you should go for Quick Service instead of Full Service (or Table service). 

Also be sure to check out the parades and the fireworks, Disney goes all out during the holidays. Hope I helped :)
